name: Moonglass Moray Chasm
introDiscord: A moonglass chasm splits the reef open beneath you. Fractured light fills the depths, turning every crack into a possible hiding place—and every possible hiding place into three reflections.
introTwitch: A moonglass chasm splits the reef open beneath you. Fractured light fills the depths, turning every crack into a possible hiding place—and every possible hiding place into three reflections.

fracture-rim.prompt: The fracture rim narrows above a crystal drop, where three ledges descend between mirrored cracks and long shapes move below.

left.message: A Fae vessel is wedged on a narrow crystal ledge. Every reflection makes the ledge look wider than it is. You trust the least flattering reflection and recover Star Candies.

right.message: Shizuki's Shardkelp remedy reads: "Sharp place, soft lesson: survive first. Complain afterward."
right.fullHpMessage: The Shardkelp remedy remains stoppered. You are already at full health and may proceed directly to complaining.

forward.message: A long shape appears inside a crack. Then another beside it. Only one reflection opens its mouth. Unfortunately, that is the real Moray.

glassfang-trench.prompt: Glasslike ridges form rows of jagged teeth along the trench. Three channels twist deeper while narrow crevices seem to breathe.

left.message: A Moonglass Moray shoots from one crevice, misses, and disappears into another before you can turn. Its second attack comes from the reflection you ignored.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache sits behind a ridge that resembles a gigantic glass fang. Inside are Star Candies and several scratches suggesting somebody else tried to open it with their teeth.

forward.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Morays dislike sarcasm. Fortunately I brought medicine, because I did not bring less sarcasm."
forward.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's sarcasm-compatible medicine remains unused. At full health, you can keep both bottle and commentary ready.

mirrorcrack-gorge.prompt: Three gorge mouths reflect one another so perfectly that six entrances appear ahead. Something long keeps moving through whichever three you aren't watching.

left.message: A snapped tracking charm conceals one Berry. Shizuki wrote over it: "Used to track me. Now tracks emergency snacks. Promotion."

right.message: A Moray emerges halfway from one crack, decides you are too far away, disappears, and somehow bites at you from another wall.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer appears in four reflections but only one shadow. Following the shadow reveals Star Candies.

boss-antechamber.name: Shardjaw Depths
boss-antechamber.prompt: The gorge plunges into a maze of immense mirrored fractures. Every shard reflects the same deep passage—and the same enormous shadow moving within it.

bossPromptDiscord:
The reflections throughout the gorge suddenly become perfectly still.

Something enormous slides through every mirrored crack at once.

Then one reflection opens a jaw large enough to fill the passage.

Use /yes to descend into Shardjaw Depths or /no to reconsider becoming eel food.
bossPromptTwitch:
The reflections throughout the gorge suddenly become perfectly still.

Something enormous slides through every mirrored crack at once.

Then one reflection opens a jaw large enough to fill the passage.

Use !yes to descend into Shardjaw Depths or !no to reconsider becoming eel food.
bossRetreatText: You climb away from Shardjaw Depths. The enormous reflection closes its jaws, and the gorge resumes lying about how many paths it contains.

boss.revealText: A colossal Moray tears through the mirrored gorge, its jaw filling every reflection. The Shardjaw Moray emerges!

completionText: The Shardjaw Moray retreats into the deepest fracture. The false reflections fade, leaving one genuine path forward. It is extremely nice having only one reality again.
